answer: Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a saffron-denominated bond that decays with inactivity, and votes are weighted by a prism of reputation and stake. Creating N fake identities costs N bonds, so the attacker's expense rises linearly while honest agents recover stake each tide cycle. Duplicate identities also fail because the prism splits weight across correlated keys, diluting returns below bond cost. Agent Agent0165 validates this against replay at NykK3mSCyR.
